page_title: VAL 3-0 ATM | Valencia v Atletico Madrid 16/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, Jesus Gil Manzano has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+2' What a wasted opportunity by Pepelu (Valencia)! He unleashed a powerful low shot from the centre of the box, but Jan Oblak makes a decent save to thwart him.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
89' Atl. Madrid have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
86' Jesus Gil Manzano shows a yellow card to Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) for a tough tackle.
83' Ruben Baraja has decided to make a change. Hugo Guillamon (Valencia) replaces Hugo Duro.
83' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Cesar Tarrega (Valencia) comes onto the pitch so that Thierry Correia can be given a rest.
81' Atl. Madrid have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
80' Atl. Madrid can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield. Atl. Madrid will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
76' Fran Perez (Valencia) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
74' Saul Niguez (Atl. Madrid) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Jesus Gil Manzano didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
70' Here is a change. Andre Almeida is going off and Ruben Baraja gives the last tactical orders to Selim Amallah (Valencia).
70' Jose Gaya goes off the pitch and Cenk Ozkacar (Valencia) comes on.
66' Atl. Madrid take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
66' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Atl. Madrid comes to nothing. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Atl. Madrid.

66' Atl. Madrid can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Atl. Madrid will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
62' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jose Maria Gimenez (Atl. Madrid) comes onto the pitch for Antoine Griezmann.
62' The game has come to an end for Mario Hermoso. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Saul Niguez (Atl. Madrid).
61' The corner is swung in but Atl. Madrid can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
59' Ruben Baraja decides to make a substitution. Sergi Canos will be replaced by Diego Lopez (Valencia).
57' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Atl. Madrid.
56' Giorgi Mamardashvili (Valencia) infringed the rules and goes into the book. Jesus Gil Manzano pulls out a yellow card.

54' 3 - 0 What a beautiful moment! Javi Guerra (Valencia) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way inside the right post. Jan Oblak just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 3:0.

48' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) connects with a cross on the edge of the box, controls the ball and pulls the trigger. Giorgi Mamardashvili makes a beautiful save to deny his effort which would have ended in the bottom right corner.
46' Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid) makes a strong challenge and Jesus Gil Manzano blows for a foul.
46' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Rodrigo Riquelme.
46' Diego Simeone has decided to substitute Stefan Savic and he is replaced by Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid).
46' The whistle blows and Jesus Gil Manzano starts the second half.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+5' Jose Gaya (Valencia) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
45' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Valencia.
44' Thomas Lemar is not able to continue due to his injury and will be replaced by Javi Galan (Atl. Madrid).
40' Atl. Madrid have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
38' Andre Almeida (Valencia) fires a powerful shot which is blocked.
37' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) fails to control his temper and is booked by the referee for dissent.
36' Jesus Gil Manzano shows the yellow card to Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) for a heavy challenge.
34' 2 - 0 Hugo Duro (Valencia) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and drills a shot into the bottom right corner in trademark fashion.
30' Cesar Azpilicueta (Atl. Madrid) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
29' Cesar Azpilicueta (Atl. Madrid) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
28' The resulting set piece from Valencia is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

27' Giorgi Mamardashvili doesn't have to worry about that one. Marcos Llorente puts a cross in towards Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid), who is unable to keep his header on target from the centre of the box. He sends the ball well wide of the right post.
23' Mario Hermoso (Atl. Madrid) sees a yellow card from Jesus Gil Manzano after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
22' Sergi Canos (Valencia) fires a strong shot to the middle of the goal and the save is unexpectedly difficult for Jan Oblak.

21' Cristhian Mosquera (Valencia) finds himself some space to meet a beautiful cross from the free kick, and from near the penalty spot he attempts to score with a header. His effort lacks accuracy and goes well wide of the right post.
21' Jesus Gil Manzano has a clear sight and sees a foul from Cesar Azpilicueta (Atl. Madrid). Valencia will take a free kick near the side line.
14' Sergi Canos (Valencia) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the middle of the goal, but Jan Oblak is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
11' The corner is swung in but Valencia can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
11' Jose Gaya (Valencia) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
10' Valencia failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
10' Axel Witsel (Atl. Madrid) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Jesus Gil Manzano saw the whole situation.
5' 1 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Sergi Canos plays it into the box, and Hugo Duro (Valencia) gets on the end of the cross to put it into the top left corner. 1:0.
2' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) was too forceful with his tackle and Jesus Gil Manzano interrupted the game to signal a free kick.

Atl. Madrid will kick-off.
